Agent Name: Boggle_Board_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake:  
The first clear mistake was made when Boggle_Board_Expert claimed the DFS/search logic was failing because “no words were found,” and then revised the code accordingly. The deeper issue is that the approach never actually solved the real task: it produced an invalid/inefficient search setup and did not identify any actual longest word from the board. The later outputs were empty because the code still failed to discover words, but the root mistake began when the expert proceeded with an unverified DFS/prefix strategy instead of correctly deriving and validating candidate words against the Boggle board and dictionary.
